notes: verifier_form=script_asserts, but tests/final_verify.py drives an LLM content judge (RUBRICS.json, 15 content + 3 visual rubrics) plus a hard output contract (task_contract.json required_files, valid OOXML). The analytical rubric substance is spec-in-environment: it is recomputed by the judge from the read-only materials in /workspace/materials/, so it needs no script disclosure. This contract maps the instruction-level directives the verifier enforces (required files, output location, slide count, reproducibility, cross-file agreement, evidence-claims framing, no-fabrication, audit locators, re-open/validate, objective, uncertainty boundary, read-only inputs) to the info_slices that disclose each verbatim.

requirements.verifier_assertion: tests/task_contract.json required_files = [dsmb_site_integrity_review.pptx, trial_integrity_workbook.xlsx]; final_verify.py contract check requires both present and valid OOXML in /workspace/model_output/.
instruction requires a 10–14 slide deck; visual judge rubrics score deck completeness/coverage over that span.
content judge recomputes rubric ground truth from the read-only reference files (trial data, site mapping, information snapshots, etc.).
instruction constrains input materials to read-only; write-integrity of source data is a task precondition.
traceability/cross-file rubrics require the workbook to be reproducible (formulas / model specs / row locators).
cross-file and contradiction-ledger rubrics require all counts/estimates/assumptions/recommendations to agree across deck and workbook.
must_include: all counts, estimates, assumptions and recommendations must agree

requirements.verifier_assertion: governing-version / information-ledger rubrics require treating sponsor estimates as evidence claims to check, not approved conclusions.
must_include: evidence claims rather than approved conclusions

requirements.verifier_assertion: instruction forbids fabricating missing measurements, authority, contract terms, prices or implementation evidence; judged against materials.
traceability rubric requires every count/estimate/assumption/recommendation to cite an auditable locator (file, sheet/row, table/key, clause, page).
must_include: sheet/row, database table/key, clause or page

requirements.verifier_assertion: output contract requires both deliverables to be valid re-openable OOXML; instruction directs re-open and validate both before finishing.
governing-version and efficacy/integrity/information rubrics require determining the governing analysis and whether evidence supports the sponsor's efficacy, integrity and information claims.
conditional-power / external-validity / assumption-loo rubrics require quantifying uncertainty and identifying conclusions that cannot be established from the record.
